I'm Afza Subhani — a graphic designer and senior social media manager who turns ideas into visuals people remember and content systems brands can grow with.

With a background in Materials Engineering from NED University and certifications in graphic design, Canva marketing, and social media, I connect creative craft with strategic communication.

On the design side, I build brand visuals, carousels, and campaign creatives. On the social side, I plan, produce, and publish content — including managing a client's recipe-focused Instagram presence with measurable reach.

SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT · CLIENT CASE STUDY

Growing a recipe-sharing Instagram presence

As a Senior Social Media Manager and visual content creator, I managed a client's recipe-focused Instagram page—from content planning and creative direction to designing posts, producing and publishing recipe Reels, creating Stories, writing captions, and coordinating the publishing calendar.

These selected Instagram Insights screenshots showcase the reach and visibility of recipe content published on the account. They demonstrate content performance; a before-and-after growth rate is not claimed without comparable baseline data.
